errors.passwordMask: {label}: enter the password itself, not the mask.
errors.lfaTiLfaConflict: {level}: LFA and TI-LFA cannot both be enabled.
errors.remoteLfaNeedsLfa: {level}: remote LFA needs LFA enabled on the same level.
errors.netRequired: Enter a NET. IS-IS needs one while it is configured; use Delete IS-IS to remove the protocol.
errors.netSelector: The last byte of the NET (the selector) must be 00.
errors.generalNeedsInterface: IS-IS needs an interface first. Use Add Interface on the Interfaces tab, which also sets the NET.
errors.lastInterface: IS-IS needs at least one interface. Use Delete IS-IS to remove the whole protocol instead.
errors.lspGenNotBelowRefresh: The LSP generation interval must be at most {max}, below the LSP refresh interval (an empty field counts as its default).
errors.lspLifetimeTooShort: The max LSP lifetime must be at least {min}: the LSP refresh interval plus 300 seconds (an empty field counts as its default).
errors.spfDelayAllOrNone: Set all five SPF delay timers, or clear all of them.
errors.srBlockPair: {label}: set both the low and the high label.
errors.srBlockOrder: {label}: the low label must be below the high label.
errors.srLocalNeedsGlobal: The local block needs a global block.
errors.srBlockOverlap: The global and local blocks cannot overlap.
errors.srPrefixRequired: Each prefix SID needs a prefix.
errors.srPrefixInvalid: Prefix {name} must be an IPv4 or IPv6 network (address/length).
errors.srPrefixIndexTooLarge: Prefix {name}: the index must be at most {max}.
errors.srPrefixFlags: Prefix {name}: explicit-null and no-php-flag cannot both be set.
errors.srv6InterfaceRequired: SRv6 needs the interface used for installing SRv6 SIDs.
errors.teAddressInvalid: Enter an IPv4 address for the TE router address.
errors.redistributeLevelMismatch: IS-IS runs at {name} only, so it cannot redistribute at {level}.
errors.levelRedistributeConflict: IS-IS level {name} conflicts with redistribution configured at {level}. Remove those redistribute entries first, or use level-1-2.
errors.tiebreakerIndexTaken: Index {name} is already used by another tiebreaker type. An index can carry only one type.
errors.tiebreakerDuplicate: This tiebreaker with index {name} is already configured.
errors.remotePrefixListExists: Only one remote prefix-list name can be configured ({name}). Remove it first to use another.
errors.remotePrefixListLevelTaken: Remote prefix-list {name} already covers that level. "All levels" cannot be combined with per-level entries.
